name: Lanyard
summary: Team ID badges hanging from a rail on straps: drag to swing them, tap to flip, then say hi
about: A team section where each person is an ID badge on a lanyard, hanging from a rail. The badges sway gently, swing like real pendulums when you drag them, and wobble on their clips as they settle. Tap one to turn it over and see what to ask them about, where they work from and a Say hi button that waves, gets a reply bubble and floats little hearts.
how: Drag a badge sideways and let go: it swings on its strap and wobbles on the clip until it settles.
Tap a badge (or tab to it and press Enter) to flip it over in 3D; flipping also sets it swinging.
On the back, press Say hi: the hand waves, the badge answers in a bubble and hearts float up.
Press the turn-back button or tap the back of the badge to flip it to the front again.
On phones the badges hang from two rails, two on each.
